description: Create a fixed-price quote for a dataset order. Freezes a clip selection unique to this order, prices it, screens the buyer's email domain, and returns a private order_token plus the agreement hash. Ask the user for the buyer's work email at their organization (consumer mailboxes are refused), the organization name, and the intended use; never invent them. Charges nothing. Show the quote and the agreement to the user before accepting.

customer_email.description: The buyer's work email at their organization's own domain. Ask the user; never invent one.

filters.description: Optional filters: year_from, year_to, categories, countries, locations, query, exclude_people, min_duration_seconds, max_duration_seconds, require_4k_master, max_clips. describe_training_dataset documents each one.

intended_use.description: What the data will train or evaluate, in the buyer's words (model type, commercial or research, how outputs are used).

tier.description: evaluation, research (accredited academic institutions only), or commercial.

name: quote_training_dataset
title: Quote a Training Dataset
